title: groundwork skill frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter at the top of every skill markdown file. Required fields follow the Agent Skills open standard (agentskills.io). All other fields are groundwork extensions.

name.description: kebab-case identifier (Agent Skills standard). Must match the filename without extension.

description.description: What this skill does and when to invoke it. This is the primary signal used by agent runtimes for auto-invocation (Agent Skills standard).

disable-model-invocation.description: Agent Skills standard: if true, only the user can invoke this skill, not the model automatically.

user-invocable.description: Agent Skills standard: if false, hide from user-facing menus; skill can only be triggered by the model.

oneOf.description: Agent Skills standard: tools pre-approved for this skill without additional prompting.

phase.description: groundwork extension: development phase this skill applies to. Must match the parent directory.

entry_criteria.description: groundwork extension: conditions that must be true before starting this skill.

exit_criteria.description: groundwork extension: conditions that must be true when this skill is complete.

items.description: id of a principle file this skill draws on.

principles.description: groundwork extension: principle ids this skill references.

time_box.description: groundwork extension: expected human+agent time investment.
